gaps.sentence: We sat ___ to the sound of the waves.
gaps.explanation: 'Listen to' means to pay attention to sound deliberately; after 'sat' the -ing form is needed.

gaps.sentence: It would be ___ to take an umbrella — the sky is black.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensible' means showing good judgement; 'sensitive' means easily affected by things or feelings.

gaps.sentence: One of the screws on the bracket has come ___.
Look at that bird up ___ in the tree.
gaps.explanation: 'There' refers to a place; 'their' shows possession; 'they're' means 'they are'.

gaps.sentence: The two designs are quite ___ from each other.
gaps.explanation: 'Different from' — the adjective is required after 'quite'.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the film, the hero rides off into the sunset.
gaps.hint: the final part of something (film, book, street)
gaps.explanation: 'At the end of something' refers to the final part; 'in the end' means finally, after a process.

gaps.sentence: She refused on ___ ; she would not bend the rules for anyone.
gaps.explanation: 'On principle' = because of one's moral rules.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.
